items.title: Family Is Thankful Their Baby, Given Weeks to Live on Christmas Eve, Now Brain Cancer-Free
items.summary: An infant girl with weeks to live from aggressive brain cancer has made a full recovery after her case arrived at the desk of a hospital which had just finished a rigorous study on her form of cancer.…
